queries.sql:
<![CDATA[WITH emp AS (
   SELECT glcc.segment1,
          decode(
             :p_external_flag,
             'N',
             person_type.user_person_type,
             'External Guest'
          ) user_person_type
     FROM per_all_assignments_m paam,
          gl_code_combinations glcc,
          per_person_types_tl person_type
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND paam.primary_assignment_flag = 'Y'
      AND paam.assignment_status_type = 'ACTIVE'
      AND paam.primary_flag = 'Y'
      AND paam.effective_latest_change = 'Y'
      AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
      AND glcc.code_combination_id = paam.default_code_comb_id
      AND person_type.person_type_id = paam.person_type_id
      AND person_type.language = 'US'
      AND person_type.source_lang = 'US'
      AND paam.person_id = :p_emp_no
),segment_desc AS (
   SELECT value.description,
          code.flex_value
     FROM fnd_flex_values_tl value,
          fnd_flex_values code
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND value.flex_value_id = code.flex_value_id
      AND source_lang = 'US'
      AND code.enabled_flag = 'Y'
),user_account_segment AS (
   SELECT lkup.attribute1,
          lkup.attribute2,
          lkup.attribute3
     FROM fnd_lookup_values_vl lkup,
          emp
    WHERE 1 = 1
      AND emp.user_person_type = lkup.description
      AND lkup.lookup_type = 'GCF_TRAVEL_BUDGET_CHECK'
      AND lkup.enabled_flag = 'Y'
      AND lkup.tag = :p_travel_purpose
)
SELECT account.segment_value1 AS funds,
       segment1.description AS funds_description,
       account.segment_value2 AS organization,
       segment2.description AS organization_description,
       account.segment_value3 AS accounts,
       segment3.description AS accounts_description,
       balances.period_name AS budget_period,
       abs(balances.budget_amount - nvl(
          balances.budget_adjustment_amount,
          0
       )) AS initial_budget,
       nvl(
          balances.budget_adjustment_amount,
          0
       ) AS budget_adjustments,
       nvl(
          balances.budget_amount,
          0
       ) AS total_budget,
       nvl(
          balances.commitment_amount,
          0
       ) AS commitments,
       nvl(
          balances.obligation_amount,
          0
       ) AS obligations,
       nvl(
          balances.actual_amount,
          0
       ) AS expenditures,
       nvl(
          balances.funds_available_amount,
          0
       ) AS funds_available_amount,
       c_budget.name
  FROM xcc_budget_accounts account,
       xcc_balances_v balances,
       xcc_control_budgets c_budget,
       emp,
       segment_desc segment1,
       segment_desc segment2,
       segment_desc segment3,
       user_account_segment uas
 WHERE 1 = 1
   AND balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
   AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
   AND c_budget.budget_chart_of_accounts_id = account.budget_chart_of_accounts_id
   AND account.segment_value1 = emp.segment1
   AND account.segment_value2 = :p_budget_cost_centre
   AND account.segment_value3 IN ( uas.attribute1,
                                   uas.attribute2,
                                   uas.attribute3 )
   AND account.segment_value1 = segment1.flex_value
   AND account.segment_value2 = segment2.flex_value
   AND account.segment_value3 = segment3.flex_value
   AND balances.period_name = :p_period_name]]>

<![CDATA[SELECT
    ds.period_name,
    ds.budget_name,
    ds.control_level_code,
    ds.budget,
    ds.budget_purpose
FROM (
    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) >= 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) < 0 THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS budget,
        'FLIGHT' AS budget_purpose
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
    WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value1 = :segment1
        AND account.segment_value2 = :segment2
        AND account.segment_value3 = :segment3
        AND account.segment_value4 = :segment4
        AND account.segment_value5 = :flightSegment5
        AND account.segment_value6 = :segment6
        AND account.segment_value7 = :segment7
        AND account.segment_value8 = :segment8
        AND account.segment_value9 = :segment9

            SELECT

            FROM
                gl_periods
            WHERE 
                TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:travelDate, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        )

    UNION

    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,

        AND account.segment_value5 = :hotelSegment5
        AND account.segment_value6 = :segment6
        AND account.segment_value7 = :segment7
        AND account.segment_value8 = :segment8
        AND account.segment_value9 = :segment9

            SELECT
                period_name
            FROM

        )
) ds]]>

<![CDATA[SELECT
    ds.period_name,
    ds.budget_name,
    ds.control_level_code,
    ds.budget,
    ds.budget_purpose

    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) >= 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) < 0 THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS budget,
        'FLIGHT' AS budget_purpose
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
    WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value1 = :segment1

        AND account.segment_value3 = :segment3

        AND account.segment_value7 = :segment7

            FROM

            WHERE 
                TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:travelDate, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        )

    UNION

            SELECT
                period_name
            FROM
                gl_periods
            WHERE
                TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:travelDate, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        )
) ds]]>

<![CDATA[SELECT
    ds.period_name,
    ds.budget_name,
    ds.control_level_code,
    ds.budget,
    ds.budget_purpose
FROM (
    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) >= 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) < 0 THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS budget,
        'FLIGHT' AS budget_purpose
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
    WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value1 = :segment1
        AND account.segment_value2 = :segment2
        AND account.segment_value3 = :segment3
        AND account.segment_value4 = :segment4
        AND account.segment_value5 = :flightSegment5
        AND account.segment_value6 = :segment6
        AND account.segment_value7 = :segment7
        AND account.segment_value8 = :segment8
        AND account.segment_value9 = :segment9
        AND balances.period_name IN (
            SELECT
                period_name
            FROM
                gl_periods
            WHERE 
                TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:travelDate, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        )

    UNION

    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :hotelEstimatedCost) >= 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :hotelEstimatedCost) < 0 THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS budget,
        'HOTEL' AS budget_purpose
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
    WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value1 = :segment1
        AND account.segment_value2 = :segment2
        AND account.segment_value3 = :segment3
        AND account.segment_value4 = :segment4
        AND account.segment_value5 = :hotelSegment5
        AND account.segment_value6 = :segment6
        AND account.segment_value7 = :segment7
        AND account.segment_value8 = :segment8
        AND account.segment_value9 = :segment9
        AND balances.period_name IN (
            SELECT
                period_name
            FROM
                gl_periods
            WHERE
                TO_DATE(SUBSTR(:travelDate, 1, 10), 'YYYY-MM-DD') BETWEEN start_date AND end_date
        )
) ds]]>

<![CDATA[WITH common_cte AS (
    SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01T00:00:00'
                ,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') default_ts
    FROM dual
),

party_details AS (
    SELECT
        hp.party_id,
        hp.party_number,
        sys_ref.orig_system             SourceSystemName,
        sys_ref.orig_system_reference   SourceSystemReference,
        hp.last_update_date
    FROM 
         HZ_PARTIES hp
        ,HZ_ORIG_SYS_REFERENCES sys_ref
    WHERE 1=1
    AND sys_ref.owner_table_name(+) = 'HZ_PARTIES'
    AND sys_ref.owner_table_id(+)   = hp.party_id
    AND hp.status                   = 'A'
),

supplier_details AS (
    SELECT
         pos.segment1
        ,pos.customer_num
        ,pos.party_id
        ,pos.vendor_id
        ,pos.vendor_name
        ,pss.vendor_site_code
        ,pss.vendor_site_id
        ,pos.VENDOR_TYPE_LOOKUP_CODE 
        ,pos.attribute5 employee_number
        ,GREATEST(
            NVL(pos.last_update_date, TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')),
            NVL(pss.last_update_date, TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD'))
         ) last_update_date

    FROM poz_suppliers_v pos
        ,poz_supplier_sites_all_m pss
    WHERE pos.vendor_id = pss.vendor_id
),

customer_details AS (
    SELECT 
         hca.account_number
        ,hca.account_name
        ,hca.party_id
        ,hca.cust_account_id
        ,DECODE(hcas.bill_to_flag, 'P', 'Y', 'N') cust_primary_bill_to_site
        ,DECODE(hcas.ship_to_flag, 'P', 'Y', 'N') cust_primary_ship_to_site
        ,hcas.cust_acct_site_id
        ,hps.party_site_number customer_site_number

        ,GREATEST(
            NVL(hca.last_update_date, TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')),
            NVL(hcas.last_update_date, TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD')),
            NVL(hps.last_update_date, TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01','YYYY-MM-DD'))
         ) last_update_date

    FROM 
         hz_cust_accounts       hca
        ,hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcas
        ,hz_party_sites         hps
    WHERE hca.cust_account_id  = hcas.cust_account_id
    AND hps.party_site_id      = hcas.party_site_id
    AND hca.status             = 'A'
    AND hcas.status            = 'A'
    AND hps.status             = 'A'
)

SELECT 
   SourceSystemName,
   SourceSystemReference,
   Customer,
   customer_name,
   Customer_Site,
   Customer_id,
   Customer_Site_id,
   cust_primary_bill_to_site,
   cust_primary_ship_to_site,
   ExtractType
FROM
(
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 1. Customer from Non-Employee
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT 
        party.SourceSystemName,
        hca.account_number          SourceSystemReference,
        hca.account_number          Customer,
        hca.account_name            customer_name,
        hca.customer_site_number    Customer_Site,
        hca.cust_account_id         Customer_id,
        hca.cust_acct_site_id       Customer_Site_id,
        hca.cust_primary_bill_to_site,
        hca.cust_primary_ship_to_site,
        'CUSTOMER'                  ExtractType
    FROM 
         party_details    party
        ,poz_suppliers_v  pos
        ,customer_details hca
        ,common_cte       cc
    WHERE pos.party_id(+)    = party.party_id
    AND pos.customer_num(+)  = hca.account_number
    AND party.party_id       = hca.party_id
    AND (
        :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL
        OR
        TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            < GREATEST(
                NVL(party.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(hca.last_update_date,   cc.default_ts)
            )
    )

    UNION ALL

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 2. Customer from Employee
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT 
        party.SourceSystemName,
        hca.account_number          SourceSystemReference,
        hca.account_number          Customer,
        hca.account_name            customer_name,
        hca.customer_site_number    Customer_Site,
        hca.cust_account_id         Customer_id,
        hca.cust_acct_site_id       Customer_Site_id,
        hca.cust_primary_bill_to_site,
        hca.cust_primary_ship_to_site,
        'CUSTOMER'                  ExtractType
    FROM 
         party_details          party
        ,customer_details       hca
        ,hz_parties             hp
        ,hz_orig_sys_references sys_ref
        ,common_cte             cc
    WHERE sys_ref.owner_table_name            = 'HZ_PARTIES'
    AND sys_ref.owner_table_id(+)             = hp.party_id
    AND NVL(sys_ref.orig_system,'FUSION_HCM') = 'FUSION_HCM'
    AND sys_ref.orig_system_reference(+)      = party.party_number
    AND hp.status                             = 'A'
    AND hp.party_id                           = hca.party_id
    AND (
        :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL
        OR
        TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            < GREATEST(
                NVL(party.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(hca.last_update_date,   cc.default_ts)
            )
    )

    UNION ALL

    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 3. Customer from ERP Supplier
    ------------------------------------------------------------------
    SELECT
        NULL                        SourceSystemName,
        NULL                        SourceSystemReference,
        hca.account_number          Customer,
        hca.account_name            customer_name,
        hca.customer_site_number    Customer_Site,
        hca.cust_account_id         Customer_id,
        hca.cust_acct_site_id       Customer_Site_id,
        hca.cust_primary_bill_to_site,
        hca.cust_primary_ship_to_site,
        'CUSTOMER'                  ExtractType
    FROM 
         supplier_details pos
        ,customer_details hca
        ,common_cte       cc
    WHERE pos.customer_num = hca.account_number
    AND (
        :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL
        OR
        TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            < GREATEST(
                NVL(pos.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(hca.last_update_date, cc.default_ts)
            )
    )
)
GROUP BY 
   SourceSystemName,
   SourceSystemReference,
   Customer,
   customer_name,
   Customer_Site,
   Customer_id,
   Customer_Site_id,
   cust_primary_bill_to_site,
   cust_primary_ship_to_site,
   ExtractType]]>

    hca.cust_account_id    AS Customer_id,
    hcas.cust_acct_site_id AS Customer_Site_id
FROM 
    hz_cust_accounts       hca,
    hz_cust_acct_sites_all hcas,
    hz_party_sites         hps
WHERE hca.cust_account_id = hcas.cust_account_id
  AND hps.party_site_id   = hcas.party_site_id
  AND hca.status  = 'A'
  AND hcas.status = 'A'
  AND hps.status  = 'A'

  -- Effective as of today
  AND (hps.start_date_active IS NULL OR hps.start_date_active <= SYSDATE)

<![CDATA[WITH contact AS (
    SELECT
        flvg.lookup_code,
        flvg.meaning
    FROM
        fnd_lookup_values flvg
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND flvg.lookup_type = 'CONTACT'
        AND flvg.language = 'US'
),
/* Citizenship: pick most recent active citizenship row per person (as-of today) */ cit AS (
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        LISTAGG(pc.legislation_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
        ORDER BY
            NULL
        )                        legislation_code,
        MAX(pc.last_update_date) last_update_date
    FROM
        per_citizenships pc
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(pc.date_from, sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(pc.date_to, sysdate))
        AND pc.citizenship_status = 'A'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id
), legislative_info AS (
    SELECT
        flvg.meaning sex,
        pplf.person_id,
        pplf.last_update_date
    FROM
        per_people_legislative_f pplf,
        fnd_lookup_values        flvg
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND flvg.lookup_type = 'SEX'
        AND flvg.language = 'US'
        AND pplf.legislation_code = 'AE'
        AND flvg.lookup_code = pplf.sex
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(pplf.effective_start_date, sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(pplf.effective_end_date, sysdate))
)
SELECT
    pcrf.contact_relationship_id,
    pcrf.person_id         AS worker_person_id,
    pcrf.contact_person_id AS dependent_person_id,
    pcrf.contact_type      AS contact_type_code,
    dname.display_name     AS dependent_name,
    pp.date_of_birth       AS dependent_date_of_birth,
    contact.meaning        AS relationship_type_meaning,
    cit.legislation_code   AS citizenship_legislation_code,
    li.sex                 AS gender
FROM
    per_contact_relships_f pcrf,
    per_all_people_f       dp,
    per_person_names_f     dname,
    contact,
    per_persons            pp,
    cit,
    legislative_info       li
WHERE
1=1
    AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < greatest(nvl(cit.last_update_date,
                                                                                       TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'
                                                                                       )),
                                                                                   pcrf.last_update_date,
                                                                                   dp.last_update_date,
                                                                                   dname.last_update_date,
                                                                                   nvl(li.last_update_date,
                                                                                       TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS'
                                                                                       )))
          OR :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL )
    /* Relationship (current as-of) */
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(pcrf.effective_start_date, sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(pcrf.effective_end_date, sysdate))

    /* Dependent person */
    AND dp.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(dp.effective_start_date, sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(dp.effective_end_date, sysdate))

    /* Dependent name */
    AND dname.person_id = dp.person_id
    AND dname.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(nvl(dname.effective_start_date, sysdate)) AND trunc(nvl(dname.effective_end_date, sysdate))

    /* Relationship type meaning */
    AND contact.lookup_code = pcrf.contact_type

    /* DOB source */
    AND pp.person_id = pcrf.contact_person_id

    /* Citizenship (outer) */
    AND cit.person_id (+) = dp.person_id
	
	/* Legistive */
    AND li.person_id (+) = dp.person_id]]>

<![CDATA[WITH common_cte AS (
    SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01T00:00:00'
                ,'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') default_ts
    FROM dual
),
emp AS (
    SELECT 
        papf.person_number,
        hauft.name bu_name,
        papf.person_id
    FROM 
        hr_org_unit_classifications_f houcf,
        hr_all_organization_units_f   haouf,
        hr_organization_units_f_tl    hauft,
        per_all_assignments_m         paam,
        per_all_people_f              papf,
        common_cte                    cc
    WHERE 1 = 1
    AND haouf.organization_id            = houcf.organization_id
    AND haouf.organization_id            = hauft.organization_id
    AND haouf.effective_start_date BETWEEN houcf.effective_start_date AND houcf.effective_end_date
    AND hauft.language                   = 'US'
    AND hauft.effective_start_date       = haouf.effective_start_date
    AND hauft.effective_end_date         = haouf.effective_end_date
    AND houcf.classification_code        = 'FUN_BUSINESS_UNIT'
    AND sysdate BETWEEN hauft.effective_start_date AND hauft.effective_end_date
    AND hauft.organization_id            = paam.business_unit_id
    AND paam.person_id                   = papf.person_id
    AND paam.primary_assignment_flag     = 'Y'
    AND paam.effective_latest_change     = 'Y'
    AND sysdate BETWEEN paam.effective_start_date AND paam.effective_end_date
    AND sysdate BETWEEN papf.effective_start_date AND papf.effective_end_date
    AND (
        :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL
        OR
        TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS')
            < GREATEST(
                NVL(houcf.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(haouf.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(hauft.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                NVL(paam.last_update_date,  cc.default_ts),
                NVL(papf.last_update_date,  cc.default_ts)
            )
    )
)
SELECT 
    NULL             CostCenter,
    emp.bu_name      Business_Unit_Name,
    emp.person_number,
    NULL             department,
    emp.person_id
FROM emp
WHERE 1 = 1]]>

<![CDATA[WITH job_families AS (
    SELECT
        jf.job_family_id,
        jft.job_family_name,
        greatest(jf.last_update_date, jft.last_update_date) last_update_date
    FROM
        per_job_family_f    jf,
        per_job_family_f_tl jft
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(jf.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(jf.effective_end_date, sysdate))
        AND jft.job_family_id = jf.job_family_id
        AND jft.language = 'US'

)

    jf.job_family_name
FROM
    per_jobs_f    pj,
    per_jobs_f_tl jt,

WHERE
        1 = 1
    AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < greatest(pj.last_update_date, jt.last_update_date, jf.last_update_date

    AND jt.language = 'US'
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(jt.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(jt.effective_end_date, sysdate))

    /* Job Family (optional) */
    AND jf.job_family_id(+) = pj.job_family_id]]>

        ,pos.vendor_id

<![CDATA[SELECT
    pos.period_of_service_id,
    pos.person_id,
    pos.date_start         AS hire_date,
    pos.period_type,
    pos.actual_termination_date,
    pos.last_working_date,
	--
    flvg.meaning           AS assignment_type_name,
    --
    paa.assignment_id,
    paa.assignment_number,
    paa.assignment_type,
    --
    ppt.system_person_type AS system_person_type,
    ppttl.user_person_type AS system_person_type_display,
    --
    paa.business_unit_id,
    paa.legal_entity_id,
    paa.organization_id    AS department_id,
    paa.position_id,
    paa.location_id,
    --
    pgf.grade_code,
    --
    pas.per_system_status  AS assignment_user_status,
    pas_tl.user_status     AS assignment_user_status_display,
    --
    pasf.manager_id        line_manager_person_id,
    pgf.attribute2         AS cadre,
    paa.date_probation_end AS probation_end_date,
    paa.probation_period   AS probation_duration,
    paa.probation_unit
FROM
    per_periods_of_service         pos,
    per_all_assignments_m          paa,
    fnd_lookup_values              flvg,
    --
    per_grades_f                   pgf,
	--
    per_person_types               ppt,
    per_person_types_tl            ppttl,
	--
    per_assignment_status_types    pas,
    per_assignment_status_types_tl pas_tl,
    --
    per_assignment_supervisors_f   pasf
WHERE
        1 = 1
    AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < greatest(pos.last_update_date, paa.last_update_date)
          OR :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL )
    AND pos.primary_flag = 'Y'
    AND paa.primary_flag = 'Y'
    AND paa.effective_latest_change = 'Y'

    -- POS <-> Assignment
    AND pos.period_of_service_id = paa.period_of_service_id
    AND pos.person_id = paa.person_id

    -- As-of filters
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(paa.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(paa.effective_end_date, sysdate))
    AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pgf.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(pgf.effective_end_date, sysdate))

    -- Grade
    AND paa.grade_id = pgf.grade_id (+)
    
    -- Person type
    AND paa.person_type_id = ppt.person_type_id
    AND ppt.person_type_id = ppttl.person_type_id
    AND ppttl.language = 'US'
	
    -- Assignment status
    AND paa.assignment_status_type_id = pas.assignment_status_type_id
    AND pas.assignment_status_type_id = pas_tl.assignment_status_type_id
    AND pas_tl.language = 'US'
	
    -- Period type

<![CDATA[WITH common_cte AS (
    SELECT
        TO_TIMESTAMP('4712-01-01T00:00:00', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') default_ts
    FROM
        dual
), person_info AS (
    SELECT
        papf.person_id,
        papf.person_number,
        pp.date_of_birth,
        pu.username,
        ppt.system_person_type,
        ppt.user_person_type                           system_person_type_display,
        greatest(papf.last_update_date,
                 nvl(pu.last_update_date, default_ts)) last_update_date
    FROM
        per_all_people_f         papf,
        per_person_type_usages_f pptu,
        per_person_types_vl      ppt,
        (
            SELECT
                pu.person_id,
                pu.username,
                pu.last_update_date
            FROM
                fusion.per_users pu
            WHERE
                    1 = 1
                AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pu.start_date) AND trunc(nvl(pu.end_date, sysdate))
                AND pu.active_flag = 'Y'
        )                        pu,
        fusion.per_persons       pp,
        common_cte               cc
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND ppt.active_flag = 'Y'
        AND ppt.default_flag = 'Y'
        AND pu.person_id (+) = papf.person_id
        AND papf.person_id = pptu.person_id
        AND pptu.person_type_id = ppt.person_type_id
        AND pp.person_id = papf.person_id
        AND ppt.system_person_type IN ( 'EMP', 'CWK', 'EX_EMP' )
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pptu.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(pptu.effective_end_date, sysdate))
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(papf.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(papf.effective_end_date, sysdate))
), legislative_info AS (
    SELECT
        flvg.meaning sex,
        pplf.person_id,
        pplf.last_update_date
    FROM
        per_people_legislative_f pplf,
        fnd_lookup_values        flvg
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND flvg.lookup_type = 'SEX'
        AND flvg.language = 'US'
        AND pplf.legislation_code = 'AE'
        AND flvg.lookup_code = pplf.sex
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pplf.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(pplf.effective_end_date, sysdate))
), citizenship_info AS (
    SELECT
        pc.person_id,
        LISTAGG(pc.legislation_code, ',') WITHIN GROUP(
        ORDER BY
            NULL
        )                        legislation_code,
        MAX(pc.last_update_date) last_update_date
    FROM
        per_citizenships pc
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pc.date_from) AND trunc(nvl(pc.date_to, sysdate))
        AND pc.citizenship_status = 'A'
    GROUP BY
        pc.person_id
), name_info AS (
    SELECT
        ppn.person_id,
        ppn.person_name_id,
        flvg.meaning title,
        ppn.first_name,
        ppn.middle_names,
        ppn.last_name,
        ppn.full_name,
        ppn.display_name,
        ppn.last_update_date
    FROM
        fusion.per_person_names_f ppn,
        (
            SELECT
                flvg.lookup_code,
                flvg.meaning
            FROM
                fnd_lookup_values flvg
            WHERE
                    1 = 1
                AND flvg.lookup_type = 'TITLE'
                AND flvg.language = 'US'
        )                         flvg
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND flvg.lookup_code (+) = ppn.title
        AND ppn.name_type = 'GLOBAL'
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(ppn.effective_start_date) AND trunc(nvl(ppn.effective_end_date, sysdate))
)
SELECT
    pi.person_id,
    pi.username,
    pi.person_number,
    ni.last_name,
    ni.first_name,
    ni.middle_names,
    ni.title,
    ni.full_name,
    ni.display_name,
    pi.system_person_type,
    pi.system_person_type_display,
    li.sex              gender,
    ci.legislation_code citizenship,
    pi.date_of_birth
FROM
    person_info      pi,
    name_info        ni,
    common_cte       cc,
    legislative_info li,
    citizenship_info ci
WHERE
        1 = 1
    AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < greatest(nvl(pi.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                                                                                   nvl(ni.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                                                                                   nvl(li.last_update_date, cc.default_ts),
                                                                                   nvl(ci.last_update_date, cc.default_ts))
          OR :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL )
    AND ni.person_id (+) = pi.person_id
    AND li.person_id (+) = pi.person_id
    AND ci.person_id (+) = pi.person_id]]>

    H1 Personal Email
    W1 Work Email
*/

    SELECT
        pea.email_address_id primary_key,
        pea.person_id,
        pea.email_type       data_type,
        pea.email_address    data_value,
        'EMAIL_ADDRESS'      data_set_catagory
    FROM
        fusion.per_email_addresses pea
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pea.date_from) AND trunc(nvl(pea.date_to, sysdate))
        AND pea.email_type IN ( 'H1', 'W1' )
        AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < pea.last_update_date
              OR :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL )
), phone_info AS (
/*
    BM	Business Mobile
    H2	Home Country Contact Number
    HF	Home Fax
    HM	Home Mobile Phone
    H1	Local Landline Number
    W3	Local Personal Mobile Number
    H3	Local Work Mobile Number
    M	Mobile
    O	Other
    P	Pager
    W2	Second Work Phone
    WA	Whatsapp
    WF	Work Fax
    WM	Work Mobile Phone
    W1	Work Phone
*/

    SELECT
        pp.phone_id     primary_key,
        pp.person_id,
        pp.phone_type   data_type,
        pp.phone_number data_value,
        'PHONE_NUMBER'  data_set_catagory
    FROM
        fusion.per_phones pp
    WHERE
            1 = 1
        AND trunc(sysdate) BETWEEN trunc(pp.date_from) AND trunc(nvl(pp.date_to, sysdate))
        AND pp.phone_type IN ( 'H3', 'W3' )
        AND ( TO_TIMESTAMP(:p_last_refreshed_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') < pp.last_update_date
              OR :p_last_refreshed_on IS NULL )
)
SELECT
    person_id,
    primary_key,
    data_type,
    data_value,
    data_set_catagory
FROM
    (
        SELECT
            person_id,
            primary_key,
            data_type,
            data_value,
            data_set_catagory
        FROM
            phone_info
        UNION
        SELECT
            person_id,
            primary_key,
            data_type,
            data_value,
            data_set_catagory
        FROM
            email_info
    )]]>

<![CDATA[SELECT
    ds.period_name,
    ds.budget_name,
    ds.control_level_code,
    ds.budget,
    ds.budget_purpose
FROM (
    SELECT
        balances.period_name,
        c_budget.name AS budget_name,
        c_budget.control_level_code,
        CASE
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) >= 0 THEN 1
            WHEN (NVL(balances.funds_available_amount, 0) - :flightEstimatedCost) < 0 THEN -1
            ELSE 0
        END AS budget,
        'FLIGHT' AS budget_purpose
    FROM
        xcc_budget_accounts account,
        xcc_balances_v balances,
        xcc_control_budgets c_budget
    WHERE
        balances.budget_ccid = account.budget_code_combination_id
        AND balances.control_budget_id = c_budget.control_budget_id
        AND c_budget.status_code = 'IN_USE'
        AND account.segment_value1 = :segment1
        AND account.segment_value2 = :segment2
        AND account.segment_value3 = :segment3
